title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Property Distribution 3459 views Q. Property share 4948 views Q. We are two brothers and three sisters and a mother. Please guide us how to divide the inheritance between us? 3758 views Q. Assalaamu 'alaikkum respected teachers, This question is of utmost importance to a family here in INDIA at this time. Let me explain. A man Abdul Wahab had 4 children, 1 son named Idris and 3 daughters. He has a common property. Abdul Wahab and his wife passes away. NOW THE PROPERTY DOCUMENT IS NOT TRANSFERRED TO THE 4 CHILDREN. THE PROPERTY IS STILL IN ABDUL WAHAB's NAME. Son Idris looks after the affairs of this property. Now the son Idris also passes away. Idris has 5 sons, 4 daughters and 1 Wife. So now when the legal heirs of Abdul Wahab wanted to divide the property, the 3 daughters of Abdul Wahab take One share each and leave 2 shares to rest with the deceased Idris family. Now my question is, a. what is the ratio at which Idris share is partitioned among his wife and Children ? b. Who are the legal heirs of Idris ? c. If Idris's wife has a share ? As the property in question is not on Idris's name but of his father. Please reply this question as soon as possible as some family members makes an issue whether to give a share to the mother. Please give this question TOP PRIORITY. Assalaamu 'alaikkum, Mubeen. 1989 views Q. Can a person nominate his or her total property to anyone instead of his or her children 1900 views Q. I would like to know how is the distribution of property calculated as in when the house is sold ( parents are not alive ) the distribution between brothers and sisters ..? 1929 views Q. Asalam alaikum, My eleder brother expired two years ago leaving behind a wife and a minor child. After some period of time recently, the widow (wife of deceased) got remarried. In this point of view we went to Darul Ifta in Hyderabad to know the Sharia Law for the child custody in such situations. They gave us saying that the Child if female shall be with mother and if male then after her remarriage the child until the age of 7 should be with the maternal grandmother if she is alive and later after 7 to the paternal grandparents if she is not alive then the custody shall be for the paternal grand parents. Now the problem is we have been seeking from the widow the custody but they are reluctant to give when we show them the fatwa they told us to keep it aside and they want to have the share from the property (the share of the widow). we have no problem in giving the share we evaluated as be the sharia law and gave the figure how much will it be and later they keep on delaying things with the intention to avoid the cutodial issue of the child. Until now the issue is pending so far we havent seek any assistance from the court. we would like to seek your kind assistance is doing the rightful. Please guide us, and show us path to safegaurd the childs mental conditions as t he mother (widow) took the child with her to his new husband. Guide us how can we enforce the sharia law, the fatwa issued by Darul Ifta. 1993 views Q. As-Salam-O-Alaikum, My elder brother Murhoom Sayed Fazle Elahi died during the life time of our father & mother leaving six children (now five as one died). Please state wheather children of Murhoom Sayed Fazle Elahi have any right or claim over the property of their grand father & grand mother. 1726 views Q. share in ancestral property 1687 views Q. Assalamu alaiqum.My father expired in 1994 ,my grand parents already expired at time of his death.my father married my mother after first wife expired. we are three brother and three sister form my mother and one step brother and one step sister from first mother. in property is 4.5 beegha land and one old house. mere sautele bhai ne ek beegha zameen aur aadha makaan le liya , woh aadha makaan maine unse khareed liya.ab 3.5 beegha zameen aur yeh makaan hai. meri maan abhi zinda hain. aur step sister bhi saath rahti hai. is property ka batwara kaise hoga. jazakallahu khair. 1710 views Q. My mother died on 25.09.1996 intestate and my father died before her.She left behind two sons and two daughters,and according to her written WILL she had said that the property No 22,Nasiruddin Road,Hussain Chambers, Park Circus,P.S.Karaya Kolkota 700-017 be divided to the four benefeceries according to provisions of Muslim Personal Law Shariat ( application ) Act 1937.Please can you divide the property according to SHARIYA AND SEND ME A WRITTEN FARAIZ AT MY ADDRESS.Your Safir Md.Salim Anzar Qasmi is sitting with me and has asked me to write to you. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 10526 Country: United States of America Title: My wife owns the house we live in. She wants to will the house to me. We have two sons but she wants me to inherit the entire property after her death. Can she make a will and do so? Question: My wife owns the house we live in. She wants to will the house to me. We have two sons but she wants me to inherit the entire property after her death. Can she make a will and do so? Answer ID: 10526 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 194/178=B/1429) The will of wife for husband is invalid; since husband is one of her heirs. It is advisable to wife that she should gift the house to the two sons and give it in their possession. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
